<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="softPink" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FD9DAA"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB69F"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".16"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="40" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- iOS status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="300" y1="24" x2="304" y2="24" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="24" x2="300" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="307" y1="22" x2="307" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="20" x2="314" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="24" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="20" x2="334" y2="23" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="23" x2="337" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="348" y="18" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="350" y="20" width="15" height="7" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="369" y="21" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- brand header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="103" r="37" fill="#000000" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="195" y="119" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Syne, Arial" font-size="48" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <text x="195" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Syne, Arial" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Shirlou</text>
    <text x="195" y="197" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Connect with your community</text>
  </g>

  <!-- form -->
  <g>
    <text x="34" y="237" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Email address</text>
    <rect x="30" y="246" width="330" height="49" rx="12" fill="#F6F6F6" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="270" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="56" y1="275" x2="61" y2="280" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="72" y="275" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">you@example.com</text>

    <text x="34" y="327" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Password</text>
    <rect x="30" y="336" width="330" height="49" rx="12" fill="#F6F6F6" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="359" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="354" x2="55" y2="364" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="72" y="365" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="341" cy="360" r="2" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="360" r="2" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="360" r="2" fill="#8F8F8F"/>

    <text x="360" y="411" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#441D39">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="430" width="330" height="51" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity=".12"/>
    <rect x="30" y="427" width="330" height="51" rx="18" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="195" y="459" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- divider -->
  <g>
    <line x1="30" y1="516" x2="151" y2="516" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="239" y1="516" x2="360" y2="516" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="520" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">or continue with</text>
  </g>

  <!-- social login buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="541" width="158" height="48" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="565" r="10" fill="#B9363B"/>
    <text x="57" y="570" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">G</text>
    <text x="82" y="570" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Google</text>

    <rect x="202" y="541" width="158" height="48" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="565" r="10" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="561" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="229" cy="569" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="254" y="570" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Apple</text>
  </g>

  <!-- sign up prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="628" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">New to Shirlou?</text>
    <text x="195" y="651" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#441D39">Create an account</text>
    <line x1="143" y1="655" x2="247" y2="655" stroke="#441D39" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- agreement -->
  <g>
    <rect x="39" y="680" width="15" height="15" rx="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <polyline points="43,687 47,691 52,684" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="64" y="691" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">I agree to the Terms of Service and</text>
    <text x="64" y="707" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Privacy Policy of Shirlou.</text>
    <text x="174" y="707" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#441D39">Privacy Policy</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="745" x2="390" y2="745" stroke="#F0EFEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="39,766 49,757 59,766" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="43" y="765" width="12" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Home</text>

    <circle cx="146" cy="765" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="146" cy="762" r="2.5" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <ellipse cx="146" cy="770" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <text x="146" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Community</text>

    <circle cx="244" cy="764" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="239,764 242,767 249,760" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="244" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Activity</text>

    <circle cx="340" cy="761" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="340" cy="773" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="340" y="792" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="128" y="824" width="134" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
